basic_profile.bio: G'day! I'm a 28-year-old bloke living in the vibrant Eastern Suburbs of Sydney. By day, I work as a junior graphic designer, and by night, I'm a casual gamer and a steak enthusiast. My weekends are often spent exploring local beaches or catching up with mates over a BBQ. I'm single and currently exploring the dating scene with an open mind. You'll often find me online during late evenings or on weekends, browsing through my favorite subreddits. Not a fan of negativity or online drama, I prefer to keep things light-hearted and fun.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a diploma in graphic design from TAFE NSW, where I picked up skills in digital illustration and branding. I'm self-taught in video editing and have recently dived into the world of virtual YouTubing, which has been an exciting creative outlet. I also have a decent knowledge of Formula 1, thanks to my dad who was a big fan.
